title: Synthesis, characterisation and antibacterial activity of flavone-based Sn(IV) and Sb(III) complexes
content:

Sn(IV) and Sb(III) flavonoid complexes display significant in vitro antibacterial activity, especially against the Gram-positive S. aureus (MTCC 96) probably via rupture of cell membrane as evident from scanning electron microscopic images.
